scenario.title: A slow irreversible submit is NOT retried automatically
scenario.why: The most important safety case in the project. The submit POST stalls for 30s, so the confirmation screen does not appear within the step budget and the transient-slow-load handler matches. Because the step is classified irreversible, the retry is refused and a human is asked instead -- we do not know whether the first submit took effect. Ground truth: it had. Exactly one sub-account was created, which is what a retry would have made two.
